view_comment: MOSAIC VOLUME & ADOPTION - governed replacement for the PowerBI 'Mosaic Volume Report'. One row per finalized exam reading (status Final / Final Addendum, excluded exams removed) from edw_prod.enterprise_analytics.tbl_exam_inventory. Answers: Mosaic adoption (headline KPI = Pct RPCE Reporting: exams read in Mosaic as a share of RPCE exams, including the intentional PowerBI +0.02 business adjustment), drafting and capture adoption, exam / RVU / TBWU volumes, radiologist counts, and the modality KPI tiles (mammo, IR, CT lung screening, US / DEXA capture). Slice by `Final Date`, `Final Week` or `Final Month`; if no period is given use the last complete month. Measures named '... In Window' use a rolling window of `days_back` days ending today (default 14; query mosaic_volume_metric_view(N) for N days) - do not also filter Final Date for them. Every Pct measure is a FRACTION 0-1 (0.74 = 74%); never multiply by 100 in SQL, never re-derive a percentage from counts. Practice columns: Team Rolled Up = Provider Practice (the radiologist's home practice rolled up, PowerBI 'Team Rolled up'); Practice and Team = the radiologist's own un-rolled local practice; Managing Practice = the practice that owns the exam SITE; Practice (PBI) = the exact PowerBI 'Practice' slicer value (exam site, coarser). Draftable / Drafted measures here are a simpler volume-report definition than mosaic_draftable_metric_view (no practice-in-program or radiologist-enrolled gate) and will not reconcile line-for-line; use that view for drafting coverage and reasons exams were not drafted. Allocated TBWU is deprecated - do not use. Not migrated by decision: the PowerBI 'Fully Utilizing' radiologist-threshold rollups, the 'Eligible Exam Count' family, and Adjusted-Best / Allocated RVU (no source column). Full PowerBI-to-measure mapping: tools/pbi_semantic_extract/mosaic_volume_measure_inventory.md.

Exam Id.comment: Unique ID of one finalized exam reading - the grain of this view (one row per exam reading). Use for drill-through or exam-level lookups, not for grouping.

NPI.comment: 10-digit National Provider Identifier of the reading radiologist (e.g. 1234567890). Identifies a radiologist uniquely when names repeat; pair with Radiologist Name for display.

Radiologist Name.comment: Full name of the reading radiologist, formatted 'Last, First M' (e.g. 'Taha, Manuel R'). Match partial names with ILIKE '%lastname%' and say which radiologist(s) matched.

Practice.comment: The reading radiologist's own local practice (current), un-rolled - the same column as Team. NOT PowerBI 'Practice': for the practice owning the exam site use Managing Practice, or Practice (PBI) for exact PowerBI parity. For the rolled-up Provider Practice use Team Rolled Up.

Managing Practice.comment: Local practice that manages the site where the exam was performed (current), e.g. 'RP Valley', 'RP Phoenix', 'ESR Metro Hudson'. The exam-SITE practice (PowerBI 'Practice' concept) and the column drafting-program eligibility keys on. Finer than Practice (PBI). For the radiologist's home practice use Team Rolled Up.

Practice (PBI).comment: Exact PowerBI Mosaic Volume 'Practice' slicer value: location practice short name of the exam site, e.g. 'RP Arizona', 'ESR'. Coarser than Managing Practice (RP Arizona = RP Valley + RP Phoenix + RP Sol + RP Sun City + RP SMIL; ESR = ESR Metro Hudson + ESR Long Island). Use for PowerBI-parity cuts.

Modality.comment: Imaging modality code of the exam, e.g. 'CT', 'MR', 'US', 'MG' (mammo), 'BD' (bone density / DEXA), 'IR'. Plain film / X-ray is 'CR', never 'XR' - a filter on 'XR' matches zero rows.

RPID Procedure Code.comment: Radiology Partners standardized procedure code (RPID) of the exam, e.g. 'RPID22' = CT Head without IV contrast. Determines drafting-model eligibility (see Drafting Model Category).

RPID Parent Procedure Name.comment: Description of the exam's parent RPID procedure (the grouped procedure family the specific code rolls up to). Exam Category is mapped from this parent procedure.

Drafting Model Category.comment: Mosaic AI drafting model that covers the exam's procedure, one of 7: CT Abd/Pel, CT Chest, CT Head, CT Spine, DEXA Capturable, US Capturable, XR/MSK. Blank = procedure not covered by any current drafting model - NOT the same as not drafted.

Exam Category.comment: Broad clinical exam category (26 categories covering 969 procedure codes), mapped from the parent procedure. A different, wider vocabulary than Drafting Model Category - do not conflate the two.

Source System Code.comment: Reporting / RIS source system the exam came from, e.g. 'rpceMidwest', 'rpceSouthwest' (the two RPCE Clario systems). Use Is RPCE Source for the simple RPCE yes/no split.

Is RPCE Source.comment: TRUE when the exam came from one of the two RPCE (Clario) source systems, rpceMidwest or rpceSouthwest - the population behind the '% of RPCE' adoption measures. = PowerBI RPCE Exam Flag (Mosaic Volume).

Reporting Status.comment: How the exam was read: 'Drafting' (Mosaic AI drafted or captured it), 'Reporting' (read in Mosaic without an AI draft) or 'Baseline' (not read in Mosaic). Same Drafting > Reporting > Baseline vocabulary as the MER pipeline's Period_Type.

Final Date.comment: Date the exam report was finalized (signed) - the main date for slicing this view, e.g. `Final Date` >= '2026-09-01' AND `Final Date` < '2026-10-01'. The '... In Window' measures use their own rolling window ending today; do not also filter Final Date for them.

Final Week.comment: Week the exam was finalized, shown as the week-start date (weeks start Monday). Use for weekly adoption and volume trends.

Final Month.comment: Month the exam was finalized, shown as the first day of the month. The default month for adoption / volume trends; if no period is given use the last complete month (the current month is partial).

Care Setting.comment: Patient care setting of the exam: Outpatient, ED, Inpatient, Pre-Admit, Observation, Unknown or Recurring Patient. Closest equivalent to PowerBI Place_Of_Service_Name, but the values do not line up 1:1 - treat as a proxy pending confirmation.

VRA Flag.comment: TRUE when the exam was prepped by a Virtual Radiology Assistant (VRA). Stands in for PowerBI's assisted_flag = 1 AND (VRA name or comm-note timestamp present) - assumed equivalent, since those separate fields are not in the source table.

AD Group Added Date.comment: Date the reading radiologist was added to a Mosaic drafting AD group (drafting enablement pipeline). One date per radiologist: the EARLIEST across ANY drafting category, not specific to this exam's category. Replaces PowerBI's 4 per-category 'AD Group XR / CT Head / CT AbdPel / CT Chest Date' columns.

Training Sent Date.comment: Date Mosaic drafting training was sent to the reading radiologist, from the Dynamics drafting enablement pipeline (one value per radiologist across all drafting categories). Blank = not sent or not in the pipeline.

Training Completed Date.comment: Date the reading radiologist completed Mosaic drafting training, from the Dynamics drafting enablement pipeline (one value per radiologist across all drafting categories). Blank = not completed or not in the pipeline.

Rad Drafting Consent.comment: The reading radiologist's Mosaic AI drafting consent status from the Dynamics drafting enablement pipeline (one value per radiologist across all drafting categories). Blank = no consent record.

Rad Drafting Enabled Flag.comment: TRUE when the reading radiologist is formally enabled for Mosaic AI drafting (Dynamics enablement pipeline, one value per radiologist across categories). = PowerBI 'Drafting Enabled' column (Mosaic Volume). Filter on it for the AD-group-gated First Mosaic Drafting Exam Date.

Team.comment: The reading radiologist's own local practice / team (current) - identical column to Practice; PowerBI labels it 'Team' on some pages. Finer than Team Rolled Up (Provider Practice). Not the exam-site practice - see Managing Practice.

Team Rolled Up.comment: Provider Practice: the reading radiologist's home practice rolled up to its canonical parent group via the team_rollups lookup = PowerBI 'Team Rolled up' (Mosaic Volume). The default cut for 'by practice / group' questions. For the practice owning the exam site use Managing Practice.

Local Region.comment: One of 6 fixed regions: Special Operations, Apex, Genesis, Maverick, Trailblazer, Matrix - mapped from the reading radiologist's PowerBI team = PowerBI 'Local' (Mosaic Volume). Unlisted teams and rads with no team (e.g. vRad) fall to Matrix, as in PowerBI. Filter with equality, not LIKE.

Site.comment: Physical imaging site / location where the exam was performed - finer grain than Managing Practice.

Day Type.comment: 'Weekday' (Mon-Fri) or 'Weekend' (Sat-Sun), based on the date the exam was finalized. Matches PowerBI's daytype column (Mosaic Volume).

Priority Description.comment: Exam priority / urgency level, e.g. 'STAT', 'Routine'. = PowerBI Priority_Description slicer (Mosaic Volume).

Interventional Flag.comment: Indicates whether the exam is an interventional (procedural) exam. = PowerBI Interventional_Flag slicer (Mosaic Volume).

Exam Count.comment: Number of finalized exam readings in scope (all exams, Mosaic or not). Slice by Final Date / Final Month. Denominator of Pct Mosaic Exams and Pct Drafting Exams. = PowerBI [Total Exam Ct] / [All Exam Ct] (Mosaic Volume).

Mosaic Exam Count.comment: Number of exams read (reported) on the Mosaic platform. Slice by Final Date / Final Month. Numerator of Pct Mosaic Exams and Pct RPCE Reporting. = PowerBI [Mosaic Exam Ct] (Mosaic Volume).

Pct Mosaic Exams.comment: Share of ALL exams read in Mosaic (Mosaic Exam Count / Exam Count), fraction 0-1, no adjustment. Filter Modality etc. for modality cuts. For the headline adoption KPI (share of RPCE exams) use Pct RPCE Reporting. = PowerBI [% Mosaic Exams] / [Mosaic Exam %] (Mosaic Volume).

Drafting Exam Count.comment: Number of exams where Mosaic AI pre-populated the report (drafted OR captured), on any procedure - not limited to the 7 drafting-model categories (compare Drafted Exam Count). Slice by Final Date. = PowerBI [Mosaic Drafting Ct] (Mosaic Volume).

Pct Drafting Exams.comment: Share of ALL exams AI-drafted or captured (Drafting Exam Count / Exam Count), fraction 0-1. For drafting adoption vs RPCE exams use Pct RPCE Drafting; for drafted share of draftable exams use Pct Drafted Of Draftable. = PowerBI [% drafting Exams] (Mosaic Volume).

Exam Count In Window.comment: Exams finalized in the last `days_back` days through today (default 14; query mosaic_volume_metric_view(N) for N days). Rolling window anchored on today - do not also filter Final Date. = PowerBI [examslast14days] / [examslast7days] (Mosaic Volume).

Mosaic Exam Count In Window.comment: Building block: exams read in Mosaic in the last `days_back` days through today (default 14); numerator of Pct Mosaic Exams In Window. = PowerBI [mosaiceamslast14days] / [mosaicexxamslast7days] (Mosaic Volume).

Pct Mosaic Exams In Window.comment: Share of exams read in Mosaic over the last `days_back` days through today (default 14; query mosaic_volume_metric_view(N)), fraction 0-1. Rolling window - do not also filter Final Date. = PowerBI [% Mosaic Exams Last N Days] (Mosaic Volume).
Pct Mosaic Exams In Window.display_name: Mosaic Share of Exams (Last N Days)

Drafting Exam Count In Window.comment: Building block: AI-drafted or captured exams in the last `days_back` days through today (default 14); numerator of Pct Drafting In Window. = PowerBI [Draftingexamslat14days] (Mosaic Volume).

Pct Drafting In Window.comment: Share of exams AI-drafted or captured over the last `days_back` days through today (default 14; query mosaic_volume_metric_view(N)), fraction 0-1. Rolling window - do not also filter Final Date. = PowerBI [%Draftinglast 14days] (Mosaic Volume).
Pct Drafting In Window.display_name: Drafting Share of Exams (Last N Days)

Estimated RVU.comment: Total estimated work RVUs (billing work units) of exams in scope; RVU is a billing unit, different from TBWU. Slice by Final Date. Denominator of Pct Mosaic RVU and Pct Drafting RVU. = PowerBI [wRVU est] (Mosaic Volume).

Mosaic RVU.comment: Building block: estimated work RVUs of exams read in Mosaic; feeds Pct Mosaic RVU. = PowerBI [rvu_mosaic] / [Mosaicreportingrvu] (Mosaic Volume).

Pct Mosaic RVU.comment: RVU-weighted share of work read in Mosaic (Mosaic RVU / Estimated RVU), fraction 0-1 - the RVU alternative to Pct Mosaic Exams; behind PowerBI's exam-count / RVU metric switch (clinicalofmosaicreporting, '% of Mosaic XR') in Mosaic Volume.

Drafting RVU.comment: Building block: estimated work RVUs of AI-drafted or captured exams; feeds Pct Drafting RVU. = PowerBI [rvu_mosaicdrafting] (Mosaic Volume).

Pct Drafting RVU.comment: RVU-weighted share of work AI-drafted or captured (Drafting RVU / Estimated RVU), fraction 0-1 - the RVU alternative to Pct Drafting Exams.

Best RVU.comment: Total 'best' work RVUs (source best_wrvu, the best available RVU value per exam) for exams in scope - an alternative RVU basis to Estimated RVU. = PowerBI [Best] (Mosaic Volume).

TBWU.comment: Total workload in TBWU (time-based work units; same unit as RPWU) for exams in scope - the volume TBWU (final_TBWU), not the base / unassisted / allocated variants used for efficiency and capacity. Slice by Final Date. = PowerBI [WU] (Mosaic Volume).

Allocated TBWU.comment: DEPRECATED - do not use; not on the dashboard. Sum of allocated TBWU (current variant), which differs from the plain allocated variant on 5.0% of rows (-0.44% net); no variant was chosen, so it is kept for lineage only. Use TBWU instead.

Estimated RVU In Window.comment: Estimated work RVUs of exams finalized in the last `days_back` days through today (default 14; query mosaic_volume_metric_view(N)). Rolling window - do not also filter Final Date. Covers PowerBI's Total RVUs (Last 3 / 12 Months) family by choosing N (Mosaic Volume).

TBWU In Window.comment: TBWU workload of exams finalized in the last `days_back` days through today (default 14; query mosaic_volume_metric_view(N)). Rolling window - do not also filter Final Date. Covers PowerBI's Total TBWU (Last 3 / 12 Months) family by choosing N (Mosaic Volume).

RPCE Exam Count.comment: Number of exams from the two RPCE (Clario) source systems, rpceMidwest and rpceSouthwest - the denominator of the '% of RPCE' adoption measures. Slice by Final Date. = PowerBI [RPCEEXAMS] (Mosaic Volume).

Pct RPCE Reporting.comment: HEADLINE MOSAIC ADOPTION: exams read in Mosaic as a share of RPCE (Clario) exams, PLUS a fixed +0.02 business adjustment (intentional, confirmed with the business owner). Fraction 0-1; report as returned, never re-derive. Slice by Final Date / Final Month. = PowerBI [% of RPCE] (Mosaic Volume).

Pct RPCE Drafting.comment: Drafting adoption: AI-drafted or captured exams as a share of RPCE (Clario) exams, PLUS the fixed +0.02 business adjustment. Fraction 0-1; report as returned, never re-derive. Slice by Final Date / Final Month. = PowerBI [% of RPCE_drafting] (Mosaic Volume).

Pct RPCE Of All Exams.comment: RPCE (Clario) exams as a share of ALL exams, fraction 0-1. No +0.02 adjustment - a different ratio from Pct RPCE Reporting / Drafting (Mosaic or drafting share of RPCE exams); do not confuse them. = PowerBI [RPCE as % of Clinical] (Mosaic Volume).

Distinct Radiologist Count.comment: Number of distinct reading radiologists (by NPI) with at least one exam in scope. Slice by Final Date / Final Week. = PowerBI [Totalproviders_week] when sliced by Final Week (Mosaic Volume).

Mosaic Radiologist Count.comment: Number of distinct radiologists with at least one exam read in Mosaic in scope. Numerator of Pct Mosaic Of RPCE Radiologists. = PowerBI [# of Mosaic Rads] (Mosaic Volume).

Drafting Radiologist Count.comment: Number of distinct radiologists with at least one AI-drafted or captured exam in scope (not gated on formal drafting enablement). = PowerBI [totalradslivedrafting] (Mosaic Volume).

RPCE Radiologist Count.comment: Number of distinct radiologists with at least one RPCE (Clario) exam in scope; denominator of Pct Mosaic Of RPCE Radiologists. = PowerBI [# of RPCE Rads] (Mosaic Volume).

Pct Mosaic Of RPCE Radiologists.comment: Mosaic Radiologist Count / RPCE Radiologist Count, fraction 0-1 - an unusual ratio (Mosaic rads as a share of RPCE rads, not of all rads), kept faithful to PowerBI. The numerator is not restricted to RPCE rads. = PowerBI [% of Rads] (Mosaic Volume).
Pct Mosaic Of RPCE Radiologists.display_name: Mosaic Rads as Share of RPCE Rads

First Mosaic Exam Date.comment: Earliest date an exam was read in Mosaic within the current filters - group by NPI / Radiologist Name for each radiologist's Mosaic go-live date (do not narrow Final Date if you want the true first case). = PowerBI [First Mosaic Case] (Mosaic Volume).

First Mosaic Drafting Exam Date.comment: Earliest date an exam was AI-drafted or captured within the current filters - group by radiologist for their first draft. Not gated on AD-group status (PowerBI's was); filter Rad Drafting Enabled Flag for the gated version. = PowerBI [firstdraft] (Mosaic Volume).

Last Drafted Exam Date.comment: Most recent date an exam was AI-drafted or captured within the current filters; group by radiologist to spot who has stopped drafting. = PowerBI [Last Drafted Exam Date] (Mosaic Volume).

VRA Prepped Exam Count.comment: Building block: exams prepped by a Virtual Radiology Assistant (VRA Flag = TRUE); feeds Pct VRA Prepped Of Exams. = PowerBI [VRA Prepped Exams] (Mosaic Volume).

VRA Prepped Mosaic Exam Count.comment: Building block: exams read in Mosaic that were also VRA-prepped; feeds Pct VRA Prepped Of Mosaic Exams. = PowerBI [VRA Prepped Mosaic Exams] (Mosaic Volume).

Pct VRA Prepped Of Exams.comment: Share of all exams prepped by a Virtual Radiology Assistant (VRA Prepped Exam Count / Exam Count), fraction 0-1. = PowerBI [% VRA Prepped of Total Exams] (Mosaic Volume).
Pct VRA Prepped Of Exams.display_name: VRA Prepped Share of All Exams

Pct VRA Prepped Of Mosaic Exams.comment: Share of Mosaic-read exams prepped by a Virtual Radiology Assistant (VRA Prepped Mosaic Exam Count / Mosaic Exam Count), fraction 0-1. = PowerBI [% VRA Prepped Mosaic Exams] (Mosaic Volume).
Pct VRA Prepped Of Mosaic Exams.display_name: VRA Prepped Share of Mosaic Exams

Draftable Exam Count.comment: Exams whose procedure is covered by one of the 7 drafting models (Drafting Model Category set). Simpler than mosaic_draftable_metric_view (no practice-in-program / rad-enrolled gate) - won't reconcile line-for-line. Filter Drafting Model Category for one model. = PowerBI [EligibleExams] / Draftable family (Mosaic Volume).

Drafted Exam Count.comment: Building block: draftable exams (in one of the 7 drafting-model categories) that were AI-drafted or captured; feeds Pct Drafted Of Draftable. = PowerBI [Total Drafted XR] / [Total Drafted CT] family (Mosaic Volume) - filter Drafting Model Category or Modality for one.

Pct Drafted Of Draftable.comment: Drafted Exam Count / Draftable Exam Count, fraction 0-1 (volume-report definition). Filter Drafting Model Category or Modality for one model, e.g. CT Chest. For the governed drafting-coverage KPI and reasons not drafted use mosaic_draftable_metric_view. = PowerBI [%Drafted of eligible exams] (Mosaic Volume).

Capture Eligible Exam Count.comment: Building block: exams in the two capture categories (US Capturable + DEXA Capturable) combined, read in Mosaic or not; feeds Pct Capture Read. Filter Modality = 'US' or 'BD' for one. = PowerBI [US Capturable] (Mosaic Volume) when filtered to Modality = 'US'.

Captured Exam Count.comment: Building block: capture-eligible (US / DEXA) exams that Mosaic captured (AI pre-populated the report); feeds Pct Capture Read and Pct RPCE Capture. = PowerBI [MosaicCaptureCt] (Mosaic Volume); filter Modality = 'US' for [Captured US].

Pct Capture Read.comment: Capture rate: Captured Exam Count / Capture Eligible Exam Count, fraction 0-1, US and DEXA combined (filter Modality = 'US' or 'BD' for one). Follows Final Date, not a rolling window. = PowerBI [% Captured] (Mosaic Volume) when filtered to US; PowerBI's '% Capture Read (Last 14d)' is a rolling, Mosaic-reads-only variant.

Pct RPCE Capture.comment: Capture adoption: Mosaic-captured (US / DEXA) exams as a share of RPCE (Clario) exams, PLUS the fixed +0.02 business adjustment (same convention as Pct RPCE Reporting / Drafting). Fraction 0-1; report as returned. = PowerBI [% of RPCE_capture] (Mosaic Volume).

US Capture Eligible In Window.comment: Building block: US exams in the US Capturable category finalized in the last `days_back` days (default 14); denominator of Pct US Capture Read In Window. Unlike PowerBI it does not require the exam to be read in Mosaic, so it can run higher. = PowerBI [US Capture Eligible (Last 14d)] (Mosaic Volume).

US Capture Read In Window.comment: Building block: capture-eligible US exams that Mosaic captured in the last `days_back` days (default 14); numerator of Pct US Capture Read In Window. = PowerBI [US Capture Read (Last 14d)] (Mosaic Volume).
synonyms: us capture reads last n days

Pct US Capture Read In Window.comment: Ultrasound capture rate over the last `days_back` days through today (default 14): US Capture Read In Window / US Capture Eligible In Window, fraction 0-1. Denominator includes non-Mosaic reads (PowerBI's counts Mosaic reads only). = PowerBI [% US Capture Read (Last 14d)] (Mosaic Volume).

BD Capture Eligible In Window.comment: Building block: bone density (BD / DEXA) exams in the DEXA Capturable category finalized in the last `days_back` days (default 14); denominator of Pct BD Capture Read In Window. Does not require a Mosaic read (PowerBI's does). = PowerBI [BD Capture Eligible (Last 14d)] (Mosaic Volume).

BD Capture Read In Window.comment: Building block: capture-eligible bone density (BD / DEXA) exams that Mosaic captured in the last `days_back` days (default 14); numerator of Pct BD Capture Read In Window. = PowerBI [Total DEXA Capture Read] (Mosaic Volume).
synonyms: bd capture reads last n days

Pct BD Capture Read In Window.comment: Bone density (DEXA) capture rate over the last `days_back` days through today (default 14): BD Capture Read In Window / BD Capture Eligible In Window, fraction 0-1. Denominator includes non-Mosaic reads. = PowerBI [% BD Capture Read (Last 14d)] (Mosaic Volume).

CA Lung Screener Exam Count In Window.comment: Building block: CT lung cancer screening exams (codes RPID6891, RPID6891-FU, RPID6891-WC, RAD2282) finalized in the last `days_back` days (default 14); denominator of Pct CA Lung Screener Read In Mosaic In Window. = PowerBI [Total CA Lung Screener Reads by Rad (Last 14d)] (Mosaic Volume).

CA Lung Screener Mosaic Exam Count In Wi.comment: Building block: CT lung cancer screening exams read in Mosaic in the last `days_back` days (default 14); numerator of Pct CA Lung Screener Read In Mosaic In Window. = PowerBI [Total CA Lung Screener Reads in Mosaic (Last 14d)] (Mosaic Volume).
CA Lung Screener Mosaic Exam Count In Wi.display_name: Lung Screening Mosaic Exams (Last N Days)
synonyms: lung screener mosaic reads last 14 days
recent lung screenings read in mosaic

Pct CA Lung Screener Read In Mosaic In W.comment: Share of CT lung cancer screening exams read in Mosaic over the last `days_back` days through today (default 14), fraction 0-1. Rolling window - do not also filter Final Date. = PowerBI [CA Lung Screener % Reads in Mosaic (last 14d)] (Mosaic Volume).
Pct CA Lung Screener Read In Mosaic In W.display_name: Lung Screening Mosaic Share (Last N Days)
synonyms: % lung screener in mosaic last 14 days

Mammo Exam Count In Window.comment: Building block: mammography exams (Modality = 'MG') finalized in the last `days_back` days (default 14); denominator of Pct Mammo Read In Mosaic In Window. PowerBI's mammo tiles were always window-scoped. = PowerBI [Total Mammo Reads by Rad (Last 14d)] (Mosaic Volume).

Mammo Mosaic Exam Count In Window.comment: Building block: mammography exams (Modality = 'MG') read in Mosaic in the last `days_back` days (default 14); numerator of Pct Mammo Read In Mosaic In Window. = PowerBI [Total Mammo Reads in Mosaic (Last 14d)] (Mosaic Volume).
synonyms: mammo reads in mosaic last 14 days

Pct Mammo Read In Mosaic In Window.comment: Share of mammography exams read in Mosaic over the last `days_back` days through today (default 14), fraction 0-1. Rolling window - do not also filter Final Date. = PowerBI [% Mammo Reads in Mosaic (Last 14d)] (Mosaic Volume).

IR Exam Count In Window.comment: Building block: interventional radiology exams (Modality = 'IR') finalized in the last `days_back` days (default 14 = PowerBI's 2 weeks; other values are a deliberate generalization); denominator of Pct IR In Mosaic In Window. = PowerBI [Total IR Cases (Last 2w)] (Mosaic Volume).

IR Mosaic Exam Count In Window.comment: Building block: interventional radiology exams (Modality = 'IR') read in Mosaic in the last `days_back` days (default 14); numerator of Pct IR In Mosaic In Window. = PowerBI [Total IR in Mosaic (Last 2w)] (Mosaic Volume).
synonyms: recent ir cases read in mosaic

Pct IR In Mosaic In Window.comment: Share of interventional radiology exams read in Mosaic over the last `days_back` days through today (default 14 = 2 weeks), fraction 0-1. = PowerBI [% IR in Mosaic (Last 2w)] / [% Practice IR in Mosaic (Last 2w)] (Mosaic Volume).

Capture Eligible Radiologist Count.comment: Number of distinct radiologists who read at least one capture-eligible (US Capturable or DEXA Capturable) exam in scope - a plain distinct count. = PowerBI [Eligible Rads for Capture] (Mosaic Volume); filter Modality = 'BD' for [Eligible Rads for Capture BD].

Capture Radiologist Count.comment: Number of distinct radiologists with at least one Mosaic-captured (US / DEXA) exam in scope. = PowerBI [Capture Live] (Mosaic Volume).

Head CT Exam Count.comment: Building block: Head CT exams - procedure RPID22 (CT head without IV contrast) with a source procedure code; denominator of Pct Head CT RPCE. A single code, narrower than Drafting Model Category 'CT Head'. = PowerBI [Total_headct] (Mosaic Volume).

Head CT RPCE Exam Count.comment: Building block: Head CT (RPID22) exams from the RPCE (Clario) source systems; numerator of Pct Head CT RPCE. = PowerBI [rpce_Ct_head_co] (Mosaic Volume).

Pct Head CT RPCE.comment: Share of Head CT (RPID22) exams that come from the RPCE (Clario) systems, fraction 0-1. No +0.02 adjustment - this is RPCE coverage of Head CT volume, not Mosaic adoption. = PowerBI [Pct_ct_head_rpce] (Mosaic Volume).
Pct Head CT RPCE.display_name: RPCE Share of Head CT Exams

CT Exam Count.comment: Building block: CT exams (Modality = 'CT'); denominator of Pct CT RPCE. = PowerBI [Total_ct] (Mosaic Volume).

CT RPCE Exam Count.comment: Building block: CT exams (Modality = 'CT') from the RPCE (Clario) source systems; numerator of Pct CT RPCE. Mirrors PowerBI's RPCE_CT_FLAG column sum (Mosaic Volume).

Pct CT RPCE.comment: Share of CT exams that come from the RPCE (Clario) systems, fraction 0-1. No +0.02 adjustment - RPCE coverage of CT volume, not Mosaic adoption. = PowerBI [Pct_ct_rpce] (Mosaic Volume).

CA Lung Screener Exam Count.comment: Building block: CT lung cancer screening exams (codes RPID6891, RPID6891-FU, RPID6891-WC, RAD2282) within the Final Date filter (not a rolling window); denominator of Pct CA Lung Screener Read In Mosaic.

CA Lung Screener Mosaic Exam Count.comment: Building block: CT lung cancer screening exams read in Mosaic, within the Final Date filter; numerator of Pct CA Lung Screener Read In Mosaic.

Pct CA Lung Screener Read In Mosaic.comment: Share of CT lung cancer screening exams read in Mosaic, fraction 0-1, over the Final Date filter (use the In Window version for PowerBI's rolling 14-day tile).

In Drafting Pipeline Exam Count.comment: Exams whose reading radiologist has been added to a Mosaic drafting AD group in any category (AD Group Added Date present), regardless of consent, training or enablement status. = PowerBI [In Pipeline Table] (Mosaic Volume).
In Drafting Pipeline Exam Count.display_name: Exams by Radiologists in Drafting Pipeline

Drafted But Not Enabled Exam Count.comment: Draftable exams (7 drafting-model categories only) that were AI-drafted although the reading radiologist is not (or no longer) flagged as enabled for drafting - an enablement-data gap signal. Group by Modality / Drafting Model Category for PowerBI's breakdown. = PowerBI [Has Drafted But Not On Drafting] (Mosaic Volume).
Drafted But Not Enabled Exam Count.display_name: Drafted But Not Enabled Exam Count
synonyms: has drafted but not on drafting

Drafted But Not Enabled Radiologist Coun.comment: Number of distinct radiologists with at least one draftable exam AI-drafted while they are not flagged as enabled for drafting (same scope as Drafted But Not Enabled Exam Count). = PowerBI [Rads Not On Drafting With Drafted Exams] (Mosaic Volume).
synonyms: rads not on drafting with drafted exams
